rule: The diagram shows four fields joined by lines. Every field starts empty. On a turn the current player either picks an empty field and places a coin on it, or picks a line whose two endpoints hold the same number of coins and places one more coin on one of those endpoints. The game ends when no field is empty and no line has an equal number of coins at both ends. The player who placed the last coin wins.
step: Click an empty field, or a field with a neighbour holding the same number of coins, to place a coin on it.
